name: dashboard-2026-10-18
source: The first start of the day with the usage dashboard (#406), after the approved mockup Crow/02_docs/mockup-crow-dashboard-2026-10-18/Main.dc.html and Settings.dc.html (Obsidian vault), as the page messages cli/crow_gui.py pushes for it.
notes: Sample data, not measured: the days come from the mockup's seeded generator (seed 1018, 53 weeks ending on today, Sunday 2026-10-18), aggregated the way the ticket describes usage_summary (levels by the quartiles of the active days, the model table over the last 30 days, largest first).
`api.usage_summary` answers the Settings page; the `dash` message carries the same dict to the start screen. --click '#settingsbtn' renders the sheet on its Dashboard page.
The sheet's other pages draw on open too; `skills`, `mcp_view`, `github_view` and `provider_view` answer empty so they do not throw on the bridge's null.
